svg.title: Kallo segmented K mark
svg.desc: The option B wordmark's capital K with its junction hidden, leaving three components: the untouched stem, and the arm and leg resolved as perfect parallelograms. The vertical channel right of the stem is 28 units (stem ÷ 6) and the vertical void between arm and leg is 112 units (4 × 28, or two thirds of the stem width) — a 1:4 rhythm anchored to the stroke weight. Stem, cap and baseline tip edges, and stroke widths are the original letterform's; the diagonals pivot slightly on the fixed tips (arm ≈50.6°, leg ≈53.4°, near the font's 46.9°/49.8°).
